description: List every automatic WhatsApp message this workspace sends to its store customers, and whether each one is ON or OFF: order/store event notifications (kind notification_template — e.g. order created, shipped, delivered, per store platform), abandoned-cart reminders (kind cart_reminder, plus older per-store ones as legacy_cart_reminder, read-only) and automation reminders (kind behavioral_reminder — e.g. product viewed, checkout started, ask for a rating after delivery). Each row has id, kind, platform, event, delay (for reminders), template info (type, languages, Meta category and approval status on an official number), active, can_toggle, last_sent_at and warnings explaining why an active message might not actually send. Also returns which stores are connected. Use it before set_store_automation_active (which needs kind + id) and to answer "which automatic messages are on?". It does NOT change anything, show message text, edit templates or send test messages.

active.description: Optional: true = only those switched ON, false = only those switched OFF.

kind.description: Optional: only this kind of automation.

platform.description: Optional: only automations for this store platform (e.g. salla, zid, shopify, woocommerce).

name: list_store_automations
